words.tr: phrase. 差一点没做（某事）；未达到（某种程度或行动）
words.ex: He stopped short of saying he was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他没有直接说他错了。
words.en: To stop just before doing something; to avoid doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 争夺；谋求；耍手段获取（优势、地位等）
words.ex: The two teams are jockeying for position in the league.
words.ex_cn: 这两支球队正在为联赛中的排名而竞争。
words.en: To compete or maneuver for an advantage or position.

words.tr: phrase. 本身；本质上；就其本身而言
words.ex: The movie is not bad per se, but it is too long.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影本身并不差，只是太长了。
words.en: by or in itself or themselves; intrinsically.

words.tr: phrase. （不幸或失望中的）一线希望
words.ex: Even though he lost his job, he saw the silver lining in having more time with his family.
words.ex_cn: 尽管他丢了工作，但他看到了能有更多时间陪伴家人这一线希望。
words.en: A silver lining is a sign of hope or a positive aspect in an otherwise negative situation.

words.tr: phrase. 使与…对抗；使与…竞争
words.ex: He was pitted against his best friend in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 他在决赛中与最好的朋友对战。
words.en: To set someone or something in opposition to another, typically in a competitive context.

words.tr: phrase. 换句话说
words.ex: He didn't like the plan. Put another way, he refused to join.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢这个计划。换句话说，他拒绝参加。
words.en: To express something differently; to rephrase.

words.tr: phrase. 某种程度上
words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；一则；一方面
words.ex: I don't want to go out for one thing, it is raining.
words.ex_cn: 我不想出去，原因之一是天下雨了。
words.en: used to introduce a reason or argument

words.tr: phrase. 竞选；赶快去请
words.ex: He will run for mayor next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将竞选市长。
words.en: To compete for a position or office in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；从...出发；违反；背离
words.ex: He departs from the usual route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他离开通常的路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To leave a place, especially to start a journey; to deviate from an established plan or procedure.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；一点也不
words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；留出；使与众不同
words.ex: His kindness sets him apart from others.
words.ex_cn: 他的善良使他与众不同。
words.en: To distinguish someone or something as different from others; to reserve or allocate something for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 形成；产生
words.ex: The company came into being in 2010.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司成立于2010年。
words.en: To begin to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 不顾；不管；尽管
words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.tr: phrase. 适应；顺应（某事物）；使自己适应于
words.ex: He had to accommodate to the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须适应新的校规。
words.en: To adjust or adapt oneself to a new situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 在…之前；先于
words.ex: He left home prior to sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他在日出前离开了家。
words.en: Before a particular time or event.

words.tr: phrase. 冗长清单；详细罗列的事项；细目清单
words.ex: He gave me a laundry list of chores to do.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我一份长长的待办事项清单。
words.en: A laundry list is a long list of items or tasks, often considered to be boring or tedious.

words.tr: phrase. 对……有影响；与……有关联
words.ex: The weather has a bearing on our travel plans.
words.ex_cn: 天气对我们的旅行计划有影响。
words.en: To have a bearing on something means to be relevant or important to it.

words.tr: phrase. 与···相应；符合
words.ex: The number 5 corresponds to the letter E.
words.ex_cn: 数字5对应字母E。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is a cause or a result of the other.

words.tr: phrase. 与…竞争；违反；与…相撞；对…不利
words.ex: He will run against his friend in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他将在选举中与他的朋友竞争。
words.en: To compete against someone in an election or contest; to be in a position that is not favorable or advantageous.

words.tr: phrase. 表态支持某一方；偏袒某一方
words.ex: He won't take sides in their argument.
words.ex_cn: 他不会在他们的争论中站队。
words.en: To support one person or group in an argument, fight, or competition against another.

words.tr: phrase. 来自；起源于
words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上...的进展；记录
words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

words.tr: phrase. 获得青睐；赢得好感
words.ex: He helped the boss, and gained favor.
words.ex_cn: 他帮了老板，获得了青睐。
words.en: To gain favor means to win approval, support, or liking from someone.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在许多方面；从多方面来看
words.ex: In many respects, this book is better than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 在许多方面，这本书比上一本更好。
words.en: In many ways or aspects.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为基础；以…为根据
words.ex: The plan is based on simple rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是基于简单规则的。
words.en: If something is based on something else, it uses it as the thing from which it develops.

words.tr: phrase. 掩饰（错误）；粉饰
words.ex: He tried to gloss over his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他试图掩盖自己的错误。
words.en: To gloss over something is to try to make it seem less important or less serious than it really is.

words.tr: phrase. 签到；登记
words.ex: He signs in to his account every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录他的账户。
words.en: To sign in means to record your arrival at a workplace, hotel, etc., by writing your name on a list or by entering your name and password into a computer.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；使…清楚明白；为…提供线索
words.ex: The new report sheds light on the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这份新报告揭示了这个问题。
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by explaining it or giving more information.

words.tr: phrase. 充当；担任；作为
words.ex: This room can serve as a meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间可以充当会议室。
words.en: To function or be used as something.

words.tr: phrase. 获得对……的支持；争取对……的支援
words.ex: The campaign drew support for the new school policy.
words.ex_cn: 这个活动为新的学校政策赢得了支持。
words.en: To attract or gather support for a particular cause, policy, or individual.

words.tr: phrase. 由……引起；作为……的结果而发生
words.ex: Problems may ensue from not following the rules.
words.ex_cn: 不遵守规则可能会导致问题。
words.en: To happen or occur afterwards or as a result.

words.tr: phrase. 反抗；反叛；抵制；对…不服从
words.ex: The students rebel against unfair rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们反抗不公平的规则。
words.en: To oppose or fight against a government or other authority, often in a violent way.

words.tr: phrase. 可归因于；应归于（某种原因或来源）
words.ex_cn: 这个错误归因于粗心。
words.en: If something is attributable to a particular cause, it is likely that it was caused by that thing.

words.tr: n. （礼炮）齐鸣；（火炮）齐射；一阵；一连串
words.ex: The ship fired a salvo to honor the visiting admiral.
words.ex_cn: 船只为致敬来访的海军上将鸣放了礼炮齐鸣。
words.en: A salvo is the simultaneous discharge of artillery or other guns in a battle, or a sudden outburst of applause or other noise.

words.tr: phrase. 不参与；退出
words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 通过解释来消除（问题、疑虑、责任等）；为…辩解，使显得不重要
words.ex: He tried to explain away his mistake with a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用一个有趣的故事来开脱自己的错误。
words.en: To explain away something means to try to make it seem less important or less bad by giving reasons for it.

words.tr: phrase. 归因于；把……归咎于；认为……是由于
words.ex_cn: 他们相信努力工作会有回报。
words.en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 来回地；一来一往
words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 服从；容易遭受；受制于
words.ex: All students are subject to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须服从校规。
words.en: Likely to be affected by or to experience something.

words.tr: phrase.  灭绝；逐渐消失
words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 相处；进展
words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.tr: phrase. 在危险中；处于成败关头
words.ex: His job is at stake if he is late again.
words.ex_cn: 如果他再迟到，他的工作就保不住了。
words.en: If something is at stake, it is being risked and might be lost or damaged if something goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.tr: 短语. 大量的；若干的（用于修饰不可数或可数名词）
words.ex: He drank a quantity of water after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后喝了很多水。
words.en: A quantity of refers to an unspecified amount or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 参考系；参照框架；观察或判断事物的立场或角度
words.ex: He changed his frame of reference to understand the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了参考框架来理解这个问题。
words.en: A frame of reference is a set of criteria or stated values in relation to which measurements or judgments can be made.

words.tr: phrase. 君主立宪政体
words.ex: The UK is a constitutional monarchy.
words.ex_cn: 英国是一个君主立宪制国家。
words.en: A constitutional monarchy is a form of government in which a monarch acts as the head of state within the parameters of a written or unwritten constitution.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: In any event, we will go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，我们都会去公园。
words.en: Whatever happens or happened; in any case.

words.tr: phrase. 一般的；普遍；未被捕；详尽
words.ex: The issue is important at large.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题在一般情况下很重要。
words.en: If someone dangerous is at large, they are not in prison or have not been caught. It also means discussing something in a general way without considering details.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为基础；根据；按照
words.ex: He made a decision on the basis of the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他基于事实做出了决定。
words.en: On the basis of means using something as the foundation or starting point for something else.

words.tr: phrase. 略微提及；涉及；谈到
words.ex: He touched on the topic of climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他简要提到了气候变化的话题。
words.en: To mention or deal with a subject briefly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 数量级；指数级差异；大致规模
words.ex: The population of the city is an order of magnitude larger than last year.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口比去年大了一个数量级。
words.en: An order of magnitude is a factor of ten. It is used to describe the size or scale of something in powers of ten.

words.tr: phrase. 推测；思索；对…进行投机买卖
words.ex: He likes to speculate on the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢猜测明天的天气。
words.en: To form a theory or conjecture about a subject without firm evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 为...铺平道路；为...做好准备
words.ex: New technology can pave the way for better education.
words.ex_cn: 新技术可以为更好的教育铺平道路。
words.en: To make it easier for something to happen or for someone to do something.

words.tr: 短语，指某种性格或特质的一丝或一缕，常用于描述某人偶尔表现出的某种特点，如 'a streak of kindness'（一丝善良）
words.ex: He has a streak of humor even when he's serious.
words.ex_cn: 即使在他认真时，他仍有一丝幽默感。
words.en: A streak of something means a continuous period of specified success or luck.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；遵守
words.ex: He must conform to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards.

words.tr: phrase. 回顾起来；事后看来；回想当初
words.ex: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 回想起来，我本该更努力学习的。
words.en: When you consider something in retrospect, you think about it afterwards, and often have a different opinion about it from the one that you had at the time.

words.w: as far as sth. is concerned
words.tr: phrase. 就…而言
words.uk: æz fɑː æz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz kənˈsɜːnd
words.us: æz fɑːr æz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz kənˈsɜːrnd
words.ex: As far as math is concerned, he is very good.
words.ex_cn: 就数学而言，他非常擅长。
words.en: When you are discussing or considering a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 摆开；展示；布置；安排；投资
words.ex: He will lay out the books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他将把书摆在桌子上。
words.en: To arrange or spread something out in a particular way, especially so that it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: phrase. 更不用说；何况
words.ex: He can't even walk, let alone run.
words.ex_cn: 他连走都走不了，更别说跑了。
words.en: Used to emphasize the improbability of a contrasting example.

words.tr: phrase. 对…做出反应
words.ex: He smiled in response to her question.
words.ex_cn: 他针对她的问题笑了。
words.en: as a reply or reaction to something

words.tr: 在……的控制下；由……控制
words.ex: The fire is under one's control now.
words.ex_cn: 现在火势在某人的控制之下。
words.en: If something is under your control, you have the power to make decisions about it or to make it do what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同；支持；有利于
words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 从…得到；从…召集或选择
words.ex: He draws from his experience to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他从自己的经验中汲取灵感来解决问题。
words.en: To take or obtain something from a particular source.

words.tr: 使...与...区别开来
words.ex: The red shirt makes him distinct from the others.
words.ex_cn: 这件红衬衫让他与其他人区别开来。
words.en: To make something clearly different or set apart from something else.

words.tr: v. 推测；推知
words.ex: He extrapolates the trend from last year's data.
words.ex_cn: 他从去年的数据中推断出趋势。
words.en: To extrapolate is to estimate or conclude something by extending or projecting known information.

words.tr: phrase. 支撑；加固；支持（尤指防止失败或崩溃）
words.ex: They shore up the old wall before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们在风暴来临前加固了那堵旧墙。
words.en: To support or strengthen something that is weak or in danger of failing.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在朝…去的路上；在向…发展的过程中
words.ex: He is on the way toward becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在成为医生的路上。
words.en: Moving in the direction of a particular place or goal.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；与...一致
words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: To happen at the same time as something else or to be the same or very similar.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.tr: phrase. 迄今为止
words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.tr: phrase. 作为……的函数；随……而变化
words.ex: The cost is a function of the distance.
words.ex_cn: 成本是距离的函数。
words.en: In mathematics and statistics, a function is a relation between a set of inputs and a set of permissible outputs with the property that each input is related to exactly one output. The phrase 'as a function of' is used to describe how one quantity varies with another.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 被遗忘；湮没无闻；消逝在遗忘中
words.ex: The old song will pass into oblivion if no one remembers it.
words.ex_cn: 如果没有人记得，这首老歌就会被遗忘。
words.en: To be forgotten or no longer remembered by people.

words.tr: phrase. 投射到；映射到；把自己的情感或想法强加于他人
words.ex: The light projects the shadow onto the wall.
words.ex_cn: 光线把影子投射到墙上。
words.en: To attribute one's own emotions, desires, or impulses to another person or group, often without realizing it.

words.tr: phrase. 睡懒觉；在于；位于
words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.tr: phrase. 或多或少
words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: 短语动词. 因……而获得认可或赞扬；因某事被记功
words.ex: He got credit for finishing the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他因为按时完成项目而获得了学分。
words.en: To receive recognition or praise for something one has done.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 暂时解雇；停止
words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 失去信誉；声名狼藉；不再受人尊敬
words.ex: The politician fell into disrepute after lying to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这位政客对公众撒谎后声名扫地。
words.en: To lose respect or trust; to become discredited.

words.tr: phrase.  涉及；关切；与…有关
words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.w: not so much A as B
words.tr: 短语 与其说是 a 不如说是 b；并非 a 而是 b
words.uk: nɒt səʊ mʌtʃ ə æz biː
words.us: nɑt soʊ mʌtʃ ə æz biː
words.ex: He is not so much a teacher as a friend.
words.ex_cn: 他与其说是个老师，不如说是个朋友。
words.en: Used to say that something is more accurately described as B rather than A.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.tr: v. 反应
words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.tr: phrase. 避开；挡住；抵挡
words.ex: Wear a hat to ward off the sun.
words.ex_cn: 戴帽子以遮挡阳光。
words.en: If you ward off a danger or illness, you prevent it from affecting you or harming you.

words.tr: phrase. 献身于；致力于；忠于
words.ex: He is committed to learning English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于每天学习英语。
words.en: If you are committed to something, you are willing to give your time and energy to it because you believe in it or because it is important to you.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己服从；甘愿接受；屈从于
words.ex: He must submit himself to the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须服从规则。
words.en: To agree to be controlled or influenced by someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 用A代替B
words.ex: Substitute a for b in the equation.
words.ex_cn: 在方程中用 a 替换 b。
words.en: To use or put something or someone in place of another.

words.tr: phrase. 只不过；仅仅是；几乎等于
words.ex: He is little more than a beginner in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上只是一个初学者。
words.en: Only slightly more than; barely exceeding a specified amount or degree.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协力；和...一起
words.ex: He uses a calculator in conjunction with paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器和纸一起计算。
words.en: Together with; in combination or coordination with.

words.tr: phrase. 大约
words.ex: He is ten years old, or so.
words.ex_cn: 他十岁左右。
words.en: Approximately; used to indicate an estimate or rough quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 从长远来看；最后
words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.tr: phrase. 控制；抑制；遏制
words.ex: The teacher holds the noise in check.
words.ex_cn: 老师控制住了噪音。
words.en: To restrain, control, or limit something, often to prevent it from becoming excessive or harmful.

words.tr: phrase. 源于；根植于；起源于（某事物）
words.ex: His beliefs are rooted in tradition.
words.ex_cn: 他的信念源于传统。
words.en: To have a firm foundation or origin in something.

words.tr: phrase. 难断气；难消除
words.ex: The old tree won't die hard; it's still green after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树难断气；火灾后它依然翠绿。
words.en: To persist stubbornly despite opposition or difficulty.

words.tr: 动词短语. 授予……访问权；允许……进入或使用
words.ex: The teacher will give access to the online book.
words.ex_cn: 老师会提供访问在线书籍的权限。
words.en: To provide the means or opportunity to enter or use something.

words.tr: phrase. 讲和；和解；休战；达成和平协议
words.ex: They make peace after a long fight.
words.ex_cn: 他们在长时间争吵后和好了。
words.en: To end a conflict or hostilities and establish friendly relations.

words.tr: phrase. 注意到；予以考虑；正式承认
words.ex: The judge must take cognizance of the evidence.
words.ex_cn: 法官必须注意到这些证据。
words.en: To formally acknowledge or take notice of something.

words.tr: phrase. 使某物对……产生影响；使某物作用于……
words.ex: He tried to bring his experience to bear on the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他试图将他的经验应用到这个问题上。
words.en: To apply something, such as knowledge or influence, to a particular situation or problem in order to have an effect on it.

words.tr: phrase. 继承自；从…继承（特性、财产、基因等）
words.ex: He inherits from his father a love of music.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了对音乐的热爱。
words.en: To receive property, characteristics, or responsibilities from a predecessor.

words.tr: phrase. 就…而言；在…方面；由…所表现出的
words.ex: The mistake was on the part of the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是老师方面的。
words.en: Used to indicate that someone is responsible for a particular action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；专心； 卷入
words.ex: He is involved in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To be included or participate in something, especially something that requires a lot of time or effort.

words.tr: phrase. 在看得见…的地方；在…视野之内；接近（目标）
words.ex: The boat is in sight of the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船在岸边可见。
words.en: In a position where something can be seen.

words.tr: phrase. 忍住；制止；戒除
words.ex: He refrains from eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他戒糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.tr: 短语动词，对……起不了多大作用；几乎不帮助……
words.ex: He does little to help his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他很少帮助他的弟弟。
words.en: To have almost no effect on something or to make almost no effort to change or improve something.

words.tr: phrase. 应该；被期望
words.ex: He is supposed to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他本该在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: If you are supposed to do something, it means that you are expected or required to do it.

words.tr: 短语. 一连串的；密集的攻击或问题（如：一连串的批评、问题或炮火）
words.ex: He faced a barrage of questions after the speech.
words.ex_cn: 演讲后，他面对了一连串的问题。
words.en: A large number of things, such as questions or criticisms, that are directed at someone very quickly and often in an aggressive way.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: phrase. v. 从…中出现；从…中浮现；从…中摆脱出来
words.ex: The sun emerges from the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从云层中出现。
words.en: to come out of a dark, confined, or hidden place

words.tr: 短语动词，没有……的感觉；缺乏对……的感知或理解能力
words.ex: He has no sense of direction.
words.ex_cn: 他完全没有方向感。
words.en: To lack a particular feeling or awareness.

words.tr: phrase. 小心地分开；仔细拆解（尤指复杂或纠缠的事物）
words.ex: He tries to tease apart the two ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把这两个想法区分开来。
words.en: To separate or disentangle something that is complex or intertwined.

words.tr: phrase. 以…的伪装；以…为幌子；装成…的样子
words.ex: He lied in the guise of a friend.
words.ex_cn: 他以朋友的身份撒谎。
words.en: If you say that someone is doing something in the guise of another thing, you mean that they appear to be doing one thing, but are actually doing something else.

words.tr: phrase. 使…更具可信度；为…增添可信性
words.ex: The report lends credibility to his claim.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告为他的说法增添了可信度。
words.en: To make something seem more believable or trustworthy.

words.tr: phrase. 挑选
words.ex: The teacher singled out one student for praise.
words.ex_cn: 老师挑出一名学生进行表扬。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group for special attention or treatment.

words.tr: phrase. + prep. 尚未；还有待（做某事）
words.ex: He has yet to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something has not happened or been done up to the present time, especially when you think it should have happened or been done

words.tr: phrase. 把……归因于；认为……是由于
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 有助于…的；有益于…的
words.ex_cn: 新鲜空气有益于健康。
words.en: To help bring about or make something possible.

words.tr: phrase. 不尝试去做；无意去做；完全不打算做
words.ex: He made no attempt to speak.
words.ex_cn: 他根本没有试图说话。
words.en: To not make any effort to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 把...视为
words.ex: They regard him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他视为英雄。
words.en: To consider or think of someone or something in a specified way.

words.tr: phrase. 定量分发；按份额配给
words.ex: The teacher will ration out the crayons so everyone gets one.
words.ex_cn: 老师会分发蜡笔，让每个人都能得到一支。
words.en: To distribute something in fixed amounts, especially when supplies are limited.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；出发；起初从事（某事）
words.ex: He starts out as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始是一名老师。
words.en: To begin a journey or a process.

words.tr: phrase. 适用于；运用
words.ex: This rule applies to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 很多；一堆；一团
words.ex: There is a mass of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一大堆书。
words.en: A large quantity or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 从属于；隶属于；次于
words.ex: He is subordinate to his manager.
words.ex_cn: 他服从于他的经理。
words.en: If someone is subordinate to you, they have a less important position than you in the organization that you both work for.

words.tr: phrase. 在实践中；实际上
words.ex: He knows the rules, but in practice, he forgets them.
words.ex_cn: 他知道这些规则，但在实践中却忘了。
words.en: Used to say what actually happens or is done, especially when this is different from what is expected or supposed to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为代价
words.ex: He succeeded at the cost of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但以牺牲健康为代价。
words.en: If something is achieved at the cost of something else, it is achieved by losing the other thing or by causing it to be lost.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 指控某人（做某事）；因……而指责
words.ex: He was accused of stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控偷了钱。
words.en: If you accuse someone of doing something wrong or illegal, you say that they did it.

words.tr: phrase. 总计
words.ex: The savings amount to $500.
words.ex_cn: 这些储蓄加起来是500美元。
words.en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total. If an idea, feeling, or action amounts to something, it has the same effect or importance as that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 在……看来；在……眼中；根据……的判断
words.ex: In the eyes of my teacher, honesty is most important.
words.ex_cn: 在我老师看来，诚实最重要。
words.en: From the perspective or opinion of someone.

words.tr: phrase. 相互排斥的；互不相容的；不能同时成立的
words.ex: The two events are mutually exclusive.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是互斥的。
words.en: If two things are mutually exclusive, they cannot exist or be true at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 临时征用；临时使用；迫使投入使用
words.ex: They pressed the old truck into service to carry supplies.
words.ex_cn: 他们把那辆旧卡车征用起来运物资。
words.en: To use something or someone in an emergency or unusual situation, especially when it is not their usual role or purpose.

words.tr: v. 解放；释放
words.ex: They will liberate the prisoners tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天会释放这些囚犯。
words.en: To liberate a place or the people in it means to free them from the political or military control of another country, area, or group of people.

words.w: no more likely to do sth. than ...
words.tr: phrase. 并不比……更有可能做某事；做某事的可能性与……一样低
words.uk: nəʊ mɔː ˈlaɪkli tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæn
words.us: noʊ mɔːr ˈlaɪkli tə du ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæn
words.ex: He is no more likely to call you than to fly to the moon.
words.ex_cn: 他给你打电话的可能性和飞到月球一样小。
words.en: Used to say that the chance of one thing happening is not greater than the chance of another thing happening.

words.tr: phrase. 团结在…周围；齐心协力支持；共同援助
words.ex: The team rallied around their captain after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 球队在输球后团结在队长周围。
words.en: To come together to support someone or something, especially in a time of need.

words.tr: phrase. 被交托给；被完全投入于；被奉献于（某事物或某种状态）
words.ex_cn: 他整天沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If something is given over to a particular purpose or activity, it is used exclusively for that purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 炫耀性消费；挥霍
words.ex: He buys expensive cars for conspicuous consumption.
words.ex_cn: 他买昂贵的汽车是为了炫耀性消费。
words.en: Conspicuous consumption refers to the act of buying and using products to publicly display economic power—of the income or of the accumulated wealth of the buyer.

words.tr: phrase. 授予；赋予（权力、权威、特质等）；使具有
words.ex: The law invests the judge with power to decide.
words.ex_cn: 法律赋予法官裁决的权力。
words.en: To formally give someone a particular quality, right, or duty, often in a ceremony.

words.tr: phrase. 有做某事的冲动；倾向于做某事；受到诱惑去做某事
words.ex: He was tempted to eat the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他真想吃那块蛋糕。
words.en: If you are tempted to do something, you want to do it, although you know it may be wrong or harmful.

words.tr: phrase. 起到…作用；有助于；用作
words.ex: This tool serves to help students learn faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具旨在帮助学生学得更快。
words.en: To have the effect of achieving a particular result.

words.tr: phrase. 对...陌生；与...格格不入
words.ex: The idea is foreign to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法对他来说很陌生。
words.en: To be unfamiliar or not known to someone

words.tr: phrase. 偏离；背离（通常指偏离常规、计划或标准）
words.ex: He did not deviate from the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他没有偏离计划。
words.en: To deviate from something means to start doing something different from what is expected or from what has been agreed.

words.tr: phrase. 在…附近；大约；接近
words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校附近。
words.en: In the area near a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 回到；返回到
words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 第一眼就；乍一看
words.ex: At first glance, the problem looks easy.
words.ex_cn: 第一眼就看起来这个问题很容易。
words.en: If you say that something is true or seems to be true at first glance, you mean that it seems to be true when you first see it or think about it, but that your first impression may be wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 反之亦然
words.ex: I like her, and vice versa.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢她，她也喜欢我。
words.en: Used to indicate that the reverse of what you have said is also true.

words.tr: phrase. 作为...的报答
words.ex: He helped me, and I gave him a gift in return for it.
words.ex_cn: 他帮了我，我送他一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for something that someone has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.tr: phrase. 完全一致的；连贯的；同一体系的
words.ex: The story and the ending are of a piece.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事和结局是一致的。
words.en: Consistent or uniform in character or quality; forming a coherent whole.

words.tr: phrase. 在表面上；从表面看；外表上
words.ex: On the surface, the plan looks simple.
words.ex_cn: 表面上看，这个计划很简单。
words.en: Superficially or at first glance; appearing to be true without deeper examination.

words.tr: phrase. 执行；进行；履行
words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrase. 一定；注定
words.ex: He is tired, so he is bound to fall asleep soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以很快就会睡着。
words.en: Certain or destined to happen; inevitably going to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 适应
words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 以……的名义；在……的旗帜下
words.ex: They worked under the banner of peace.
words.ex_cn: 他们以和平的名义合作。
words.en: Under the name or authority of; acting in the cause of a particular group or idea.

words.tr: phrase. 把某事置于高优先级；高度重视某事；优先考虑某事
words.ex: The government made clean water a high priority.
words.ex_cn: 政府把清洁用水列为首要任务。
words.en: To treat something as being very important and needing to be dealt with before other things.

words.tr: phrase. 发生；造成
words.ex: How did this mistake come about?
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是怎么发生的？
words.en: If you ask how something came about, you want to know how it happened or started.

words.tr: phrase. 在进行中
words.ex: The project is under way.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If an activity is under way, it has already started.

words.tr: 短语，一连串；一系列（通常指短时间内接连发生的不好的事情）
words.ex: A spate of storms hit the coast last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周有一连串风暴袭击了海岸。
words.en: A spate of something is a large number of similar things that happen in a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 从某种程度上来说
words.ex: He is late to some degree because of traffic.
words.ex_cn: 由于交通拥堵，他有点迟到。
words.en: To some extent; partly.

words.tr: phrase. 决不；一点也不
words.ex: He is anything but lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不是懒惰的。
words.en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but happy to emphasize that something is not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；关于；至于
words.ex: We need to decide with respect to the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到天气来做出决定。
words.en: Regarding or concerning something.

words.tr: phrase. （时间）悄悄流逝；（机会等）被错过
words.ex: Time slips by when we are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当我们快乐时，时间悄悄溜走。
words.en: If time slips by, it passes quickly and often without you noticing.

words.tr: phrase. 把…带到；导致；通向
words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 在…之前；提前于；早于
words.ex: He paid the bill in advance of the due date.
words.ex_cn: 他在到期日之前付了账单。
words.en: Before something happens or is expected to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 到目前为止；迄今
words.ex: Thus far, he has passed all his exams.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他通过了所有考试。
words.en: Up to this point in time; so far.

words.tr: phrase. 把问题搁置不解决；让问题悬而未决；暂不给出定论
words.ex: He decides to leave the question open.
words.ex_cn: 他决定让这个问题留待后续讨论。
words.en: To not decide or settle an issue; to keep a matter unresolved.

words.tr: phrase. v. 艰苦地完成；勉强写出；费力地生产
words.ex: He grinds out math problems every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上苦算数学题。
words.en: To produce something in a mechanical or unenthusiastic way, especially something that requires a lot of effort or is of low quality.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为理由；基于…的原因
words.ex: He was denied entry on grounds of safety.
words.ex_cn: 他以安全为由被拒绝进入。
words.en: for the reason of; because of

words.tr: phrase. 比…优越；比…高级；胜过
words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If one thing or person is superior to another, the first is better than the second.

words.tr: phrase. 把…强加于…；使…承担（义务、负担等）；把（想法、信仰等）强行施加于…
words.ex: The teacher imposed a rule on the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们施加了一条规则。
words.en: To impose something on someone means to force them to accept it, often something that is unwelcome or that they do not want.

words.tr: phrase. 忍受；容忍
words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.tr: phrase. 更加；愈发（用于加强比较或强调程度）
words.ex: He was tired, but all the more determined to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，但更加决心完成比赛。
words.en: You use 'all the more' to emphasize that something is even more the case than usual.

words.tr: phrase. 等等
words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so forth.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could be mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 优先于；比…更重要
words.ex: Safety takes precedence over speed.
words.ex_cn: 安全比速度更重要。
words.en: To be more important than something else and to be dealt with first.

words.tr: phrase. 与…相似；类似于
words.ex: This song is akin to a lullaby.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌类似于摇篮曲。
words.en: To be similar to something in character or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 归因于；归功于；由于
words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe something to someone or something, it is because of them that you have it or experience it.

words.tr: phrase. 应付；处理
words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 划去；排除
words.ex: He ruled out the wrong answer on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中划去了错误的答案。
words.en: To decide that something is not possible or not worth considering.

words.tr: phrase. 使降职；把…降级；把…归入（次要地位）；把…委托给
words.ex: He was relegated to a lower position after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他在犯错后被降职到更低的职位。
words.en: To assign to a lower rank or position; to consign to a less important status.

words.tr: phrase. 与…同等水平；与…不相上下；与…旗鼓相当
words.ex: His score is on a par with hers.
words.ex_cn: 他的分数和她的相当。
words.en: If you say that two people or things are on a par with each other, you mean that they are equally good or bad, or equally important.

words.tr: phrase. 易受影响的；易受感染的；易受诱惑的
words.ex_cn: 孩子在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: Easily influenced, affected, or harmed by something; vulnerable.

words.tr: phrase. 对...表示怀疑； 对...表示异议
words.ex: The new evidence calls the witness's story into question.
words.ex_cn: 新的证据对证人的说法提出了质疑。
words.en: If something calls into question a fact, principle, or belief, it makes people doubt whether it is true, valid, or reliable.

words.tr: phrase. 根据；鉴于
words.ex: He changed his plan in light of the new weather forecast.
words.ex_cn: 根据新的天气预报，他改变了计划。
words.en: Used to introduce a fact or situation that is the reason for a particular action or decision.

words.tr: phrase. 根据；鉴于
words.ex: He changed his mind in the light of new facts.
words.ex_cn: 根据新事实，他改变了主意。
words.en: If you do or decide something in the light of something else, you do it or decide it after considering that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起武器反抗；武装起来对抗
words.ex: The villagers took up arms against the invaders.
words.ex_cn: 村民们拿起武器反抗入侵者。
words.en: To begin fighting or opposing someone or something, especially using weapons.

words.tr: phrase. 面对
words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏的；没有的（通常与 'of' 连用，表示完全缺少某种特质或事物）
words.ex: The room was devoid of furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有家具。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is devoid of a quality or thing, you are emphasizing that they have none of it.

words.tr: phrase. 免于；摆脱（某事物），不受……的困扰
words.ex: He wants to be free from stress.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱压力。
words.en: To not have or be affected by something unwanted.

words.tr: phrase. 另一方面
words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；提出；想出
words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 未能达到；不足；不够
words.ex: He fell short of the target score.
words.ex_cn: 他没能达到目标分数。
words.en: To not reach the standard or level that is expected or required.

words.tr: phrase. 侵犯；影响；干涉；对…产生冲击
words.ex: The new rule should not impinge on our rights.
words.ex_cn: 这项新规定不应侵犯我们的权利。
words.en: To have an effect or influence, especially a negative one, on something.

words.tr: phrase. 举手打（某人）；威胁或伤害（某人）；对…使用暴力
words.ex: He would never raise a hand against his child.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不会举手打自己的孩子。
words.en: To threaten or attempt to harm someone.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种意义上
words.ex: In a sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: You say in a sense to indicate that a statement is true in one way, but not in others.

words.tr: phrase. 为…留出余地；给…留下空间
words.ex: Leave room for your brother to sit.
words.ex_cn: 给你弟弟留个座位。
words.en: To allow space or opportunity for something to happen or be considered.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺…的…；使丧失…
words.ex: The storm deprived the village of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使村庄失去了电力。
words.en: To take something away from someone; to prevent someone from having or using something.

words.tr: phrase. 给予；处置
words.ex: The teacher will mete out punishment for cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师会对作弊行为进行惩罚。
words.en: To distribute or allocate something, especially punishment or rewards, in a measured or determined way.

words.tr: phrase. 以……告终；最终导致……；达到顶点并以……结束
words.ex: The long journey culminated in a beautiful sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这段漫长的旅程以美丽的日落告终。
words.en: To culminate in something means to reach the highest point or final stage of it, often after a period of development or progress.

words.tr: phrase. 导致
words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 被……迷住的；对……感到眼花缭乱的
words.ex_cn: 他被耀眼的灯光迷住了。
words.en: To be so impressed or overwhelmed by something that it becomes difficult to think clearly or see properly, often because of its brightness, beauty, or brilliance.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 鉴于；考虑到；由于
words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.tr: phrase. 专心阅读；钻研
words.ex: He pores over his math book every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都仔细研读他的数学书。
words.en: If you pore over or through information, you look at it and study it very carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细研读；认真钻研；深入查阅
words.ex: He pored through the old books to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细翻阅旧书寻找答案。
words.en: To read or study something very carefully and thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于；由…产生；从…中突然出现
words.ex: The idea sprang from a simple conversation.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法源于一次简单的对话。
words.en: To originate or emerge suddenly from a source or cause.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；除...之外
words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 打个比方；作类比，通过比较两个不同事物的相似之处来解释或说明问题
words.ex: He draws an analogy between math and music.
words.ex_cn: 他将数学和音乐进行类比。
words.en: To make a comparison between two things to highlight similarities.

words.tr: phrase. 直到……才；在……之前不
words.ex: He did not leave until his mother came back.
words.ex_cn: 直到他妈妈回来，他才离开。
words.en: used to emphasize that something does not happen before a certain point in time

words.tr: phrase. 倾向于
words.ex: He is inclined to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 他倾向于早起。
words.en: If you are inclined to do something, you want to do it or you are likely to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 引起；导致
words.ex: Poor hygiene can give rise to infections.
words.ex_cn: 不良的卫生习惯可能导致感染。
words.en: To cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 远远超过；远在……之外
words.ex: The speed of this car is far beyond my old one.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的速度远远超过我的旧车。
words.en: To a great degree or extent; much further than.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 利用，凭借（经验、资源等）；动用
words.ex: He draws upon his old experience to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他利用自己的旧经验来解决问题。
words.en: To make use of something, especially a resource or a quality, in order to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 证明；证实；作证
words.ex: The report attests to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告证明了他的努力。
words.en: To provide or serve as clear evidence of.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；劝阻（某人）做某事
words.ex: The rain deterred him from going for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 下雨阻止了他去散步。
words.en: If something deters you from doing something, it makes you not want to do it or continue doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 刻意努力做某事；费心尽力去做
words.ex: He takes pains to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都认真完成作业。
words.en: If you take pains to do something, you try hard to do it, especially because you think it is important.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr: 短语动词，为……而战；为争取……而斗争
words.ex: They are battling for the championship title.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在为冠军头衔而战。
words.en: To fight or contend for something, typically in a determined and vigorous way.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；应归于
words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 共有
words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 与…相同；和…一样；与…共有
words.ex: He likes apples, in common with his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，和他妹妹一样。
words.en: If someone or something has something in common with another person or thing, they share the same interests or characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 与……关系不大；与……几乎没有关联
words.ex: The weather has little to do with his decision.
words.ex_cn: 天气和他的决定没什么关系。
words.en: To be not very much connected with or involved in something.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…
words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 在…上投资
words.ex: He wants to invest in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他想投资一家小企业。
words.en: To put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or achieve a result.

words.tr: phrase. 尤其；特别
words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr: 短语. 与…不一致；与…有矛盾；与…争吵
words.ex: He is at odds with his brother over money.
words.ex_cn: 他因为钱的问题和他哥哥意见不合。
words.en: In disagreement or conflict with someone or something.

words.tr: 短语. 某种程度上的衡量；…的度量
words.ex: His patience is a measure of his kindness.
words.ex_cn: 他的耐心在某种程度上衡量了他的善良。
words.en: A measure of something is a way of determining the size, amount, or degree of it, or a unit used for this purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 解决争端；调解纠纷
words.ex: They agreed to settle a dispute with a handshake.
words.ex_cn: 他们同意通过握手来解决争端。
words.en: To resolve a disagreement or conflict between parties.

words.tr: pron. 它们（宾格）；他们；她们；
words.ex: I saw them in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里看到了它们。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr: phrase. 落入；陷入；属于
words.ex: He fell into the river by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心掉进了河里。
words.en: To fall into something means to be classified or divided into it, or to start to be in a particular state or condition.

words.tr: phrase. v. 把……归功于某人；认为某人具有（某种品质、成就等）
words.ex: They credit her with inventing the new math method.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为她发明了这种新的数学方法。
words.en: To believe or say that someone is responsible for a particular achievement or good quality.

words.tr: phrase. 关于；至于；就……而言
words.ex: He spoke with regard to the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新规定。
words.en: Used to introduce the subject that one is going to talk or write about.

words.tr: phrase. 与…成比例的；与…相称的
words.ex: The cost is proportional to the size.
words.ex_cn: 成本与大小成正比。
words.en: If one amount is proportional to another, the two amounts increase and decrease at the same rate so there is always the same relationship between them.

words.tr: phrase. 受…支配；任…摆布
words.ex: The boat was at the mercy of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 船听任风暴摆布。
words.en: If one person or thing is at the mercy of another, the first person or thing is in a situation where they cannot prevent themselves being harmed or affected by the second.

words.tr: phrase. 在这个意义上；就这层含义而言
words.ex: In this sense, happiness means peace of mind.
words.ex_cn: 在这个意义上，幸福意味着内心的平静。
words.en: Used to specify the particular way in which something is being considered or referred to.

words.tr: phrase. 重视；考虑；顾及
words.ex: The teacher took into account his effort, not just his grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师重视他的努力，而不仅仅是他的分数。
words.en: To consider or remember something when judging a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 接近；濒临；几乎达到（某种状态或程度）
words.ex: His behavior verges on rude.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为近乎粗鲁。
words.en: To be very close to something, especially in quality, amount, or effect, but not exactly the same.

words.tr: phrase. 被灌注有；充满（某种思想、情感或品质）
words.ex: He is imbued with passion for music.
words.ex_cn: 他充满对音乐的热爱。
words.en: To be filled or saturated with a particular quality or feeling.

words.tr: phrase. 对……施加影响
words.ex: Parents can exert influence on their children's habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母可以对孩子的习惯产生影响。
words.en: To exert influence on someone or something means to use your power or abilities in order to affect their actions, decisions, or opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 转移注意力的话题；烟幕弹；故意误导的线索
words.ex: The politician used a red herring to avoid the real question.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家用了一个转移注意力的手段来回避真正的问题。
words.en: A red herring is something that misleads or distracts from a relevant or important issue. It may be either a logical fallacy or a literary device that leads readers or audiences towards a false conclusion.

words.tr: phrase. 免除；省掉；没有也行
words.ex: He decided to dispense with the formal dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他决定取消正式的晚宴。
words.en: If you dispense with something, you stop using it or get rid of it, usually because you no longer need it.

words.tr: phrase. 与…同住；归属于；由…负责
words.ex: He resides with his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他与祖父母同住。
words.en: If responsibility or power resides with someone, it is their responsibility or power to deal with something.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.tr: phrase. 和…联系在一起；与…有关
words.ex: He is associated with the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他与当地医院有关联。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 设法做成；努力完成；成功做到
words.ex: He managed to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To succeed in doing something, often despite difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 戒除；抛弃；由…产生
words.ex: He grew out of biting his nails when he became a teenager.
words.ex_cn: 他当了青少年后就戒掉了咬指甲的习惯。
words.en: If you grow out of a habit or a type of behaviour, you stop doing it or having it because you are older and more mature.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…表示怀疑；使对…产生疑虑
words.ex: The new evidence cast doubt on his story.
words.ex_cn: 新的证据使他的说法受到怀疑。
words.en: To make people uncertain about something.

words.tr: phrase. 有效；实际上
words.ex: The new rule is in effect from Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规定从周一开始生效。
words.en: If a law or rule is in effect, it is operating or being applied.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；总的来说
words.ex: By and large, he is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他是个好学生。
words.en: You use 'by and large' to indicate that a statement is mostly but not completely true.

words.tr: phrase. 不足为奇；并不令人惊讶
words.ex: His winning the prize comes as no surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他获奖并不令人惊讶。
words.en: If something comes as no surprise, it does not surprise you because you were expecting it to happen.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…大有帮助；在很大程度上促成…
words.ex: Eating healthy goes a long way toward staying strong.
words.ex_cn: 健康饮食有助于保持强壮。
words.en: To be very helpful in achieving something or making something possible.

words.tr: phrase. 提出（观点、理论等）；伸出；发挥；使长出（芽、叶等）
words.ex: He put forth a new idea at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To present or propose something for consideration; to exert or extend.

words.tr: phrase. 将A奉献给B；把A用于B（如时间、精力、资源等）
words.ex: He dedicates his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他把时间投入到帮助孩子身上。
words.en: To devote or commit (something, such as time, effort, or resources) to a particular task or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 在…面前；当着…的面；有…在场时
words.ex: He stayed quiet in the presence of his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师面前保持安静。
words.en: When you are in the presence of someone or something, you are in the same place as them and they are there with you.

words.tr: phrase. 由…起源；来自
words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.tr: phrase. 不少于；多达；竟然；正是
words.ex: He has no less than five brothers and sisters.
words.ex_cn: 他有整整五个兄弟姐妹。
words.en: used to emphasize that a particular number, amount, etc., is surprisingly large

words.tr: phrase. 适合
words.ex: The new shelf does not fit into the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个新架子放不进角落里。
words.en: If you fit into a group or situation, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people involved.

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；对比而言
words.ex: He likes coffee. By contrast, she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡。相比之下，她更喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr:
adj. 歪的；斜的；曲解的
v. 使歪斜；歪曲；曲解
words.ex: The picture on the wall is skew.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的画是歪的。
words.en: If something is skew, it is not straight or not arranged correctly.

words.tr: phrase. v. 不加怀疑地接受某事的表面价值；认为某事正如其表面上看起来那样
words.ex_cn: 不要轻易相信他的话。
words.en: To accept something at face value means to accept it as it appears, without questioning or investigating it further.

words.tr: phrase. 表面理解某事物；不加怀疑地接受某事的表面价值或说法
words.ex: Don't take his words at face value.
words.ex_cn: 不要表面化地相信他的话。
words.en: To accept something as it appears to be without questioning its truth or validity.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于；参加
words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 艰巨的任务；极其困难的工作
words.ex: Finishing the project in one day is a herculean task.
words.ex_cn: 一天内完成这个项目是一项艰巨的任务。
words.en: A task requiring a great amount of strength or effort, akin to the labors of Hercules.

words.tr: 短语. 广泛的...范围；各种各样的...
words.ex: The school offers a wide spectrum of subjects.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校提供广泛的各种科目。
words.en: A wide spectrum of refers to a broad range or variety of something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使显露；揭示；暴露（某事）
words.ex: The report brought to light the truth.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告揭示了真相。
words.en: To reveal or uncover something that was previously hidden or unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地；有限度地
words.ex: I agree with him up to a point.
words.ex_cn: 我部分同意他的观点。
words.en: To some extent but not completely.

words.tr: 短语，一阵……的爆发，突然的一股……
words.ex: There was a burst of laughter when he told the joke.
words.ex_cn: 他讲完笑话时，突然爆发出一阵笑声。
words.en: A sudden, intense expression or occurrence of something.

words.tr: phrase. 有园艺才能的人；擅长种植植物的能力
words.ex: He has a green thumb and grows beautiful flowers.
words.ex_cn: 他很有园艺天赋，能种出美丽的花。
words.en: If someone has a green thumb, they are very good at gardening and their plants grow well.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；提出；陈列；出发；把…提前
words.ex: He set forth his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地提出了自己的想法。
words.en: To present or introduce something, such as an idea, plan, or argument, in a clear and detailed way.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠，求助于；诉诸
words.ex: He had to resort to asking for help.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不求助于别人。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because other methods have failed.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于；着迷于
words.ex: He is obsessed with video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: To be completely preoccupied with a particular thought or feeling, often to an unhealthy degree.

words.tr: phrase. 只有；仅仅
words.ex: He has nothing but praise for his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师只有赞美。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is only what you say it is and nothing more

words.tr: phrase. 使暴露于……；使接触……；使面临……
words.ex: Parents should expose children to books early.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该让孩子从小接触书籍。
words.en: To make something vulnerable or subject to something else, often negative.

words.tr: phrase. （使）磨损；消逝；磨减
words.ex: The wind wears away the rock slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢地磨损了石头。
words.en: To erode or diminish gradually through friction, use, or exposure.

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；力争达成某事
words.ex: He strives to do his best every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都努力做到最好。
words.en: To make great efforts to achieve or obtain something.

words.tr: phrase. 与...无关
words.ex: This problem has nothing to do with math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学无关。
words.en: If you say that something has nothing to do with a particular subject or situation, you mean that it is not connected with it in any way.

words.tr: phrase. 值得注意；应予以关注
words.ex: His work merits attention because it is very creative.
words.ex_cn: 他的作品很有创意，值得关注。
words.en: If something merits attention, it deserves to be given attention because it is important or interesting.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；区别；加以辨别
words.ex: He makes a distinction between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他区分对与错。
words.en: To recognize or point out a difference between things.

words.tr: phrase. 紧附；紧抓；坚持
words.ex: He still clings to his old beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然坚持自己的旧信念。
words.en: To hold on tightly to something or someone, either physically or emotionally, often because of fear, love, or a strong desire.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 紧紧抓住；坚持不放
words.ex: He clings on to his old toy.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧抓着他的旧玩具。
words.en: To hold on tightly to something or someone, often out of fear, desperation, or a strong desire not to lose it or them.

words.tr: phrase. 遭受同样的命运；经历相同的结局
words.ex: The two cities suffered the same fate after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 这两座城市在地震后遭遇了相同的命运。
words.en: To experience the same outcome or destiny, often a negative one, as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 不包括；除…以外
words.ex: Aside from John, everyone went to the party.
words.ex_cn: 不包括约翰，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use aside from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 分成；分裂成（多个部分）
words.ex: They split into two groups to finish the work faster.
words.ex_cn: 他们分成两组，以便更快地完成工作。
words.en: To divide or separate into distinct parts or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 起于；由…引起
words.ex: The problem arises from a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于一个简单的错误。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises from a particular event or activity, it is caused by it.

words.tr: phrase. 提出
words.ex: He put forward a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To suggest or propose something for consideration.

words.tr: n. 错误；差错；
words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.tr: phrase. 处理好；处置掉；除掉
words.ex: Please dispose of the trash before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前处理好垃圾。
words.en: To get rid of something that you no longer want or need.

words.tr: phrase. 利用；接入；汲取（资源、能量、信息等）
words.ex: He taps into his savings to pay for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他动用储蓄来支付旅行费用。
words.en: To make use of a source of energy, knowledge, etc. that already exists.

words.tr: phrase. 装备；使具备
words.ex: The soldiers were equipped with new rifles.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们配备了新步枪。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 凭借…的力量；由于
words.ex: He passed the test by virtue of his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Because of or as a result of something.

words.tr: phrase. 警告不要；劝告提防
words.ex: The doctor cautioned against eating too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生警告不要吃太多糖。
words.en: To warn someone not to do something.

words.tr: 短语. 一个恰当的例子；恰如其分的例证
words.ex: He never studies, and fails every test — a case in point.
words.ex_cn: 他从不学习，每次考试都挂科——这就是一个恰当的例子。
words.en: A case in point is a clear and appropriate example that supports or illustrates a point being made.

words.tr: phrase. 就其本质而言；天生地
words.ex: He is by nature a quiet person.
words.ex_cn: 他天性安静。
words.en: If someone has a particular quality by nature, they have it as a natural part of their character.

words.tr: phrase. 轻快地走过；顺利通过
words.ex: He sailed through the hallway without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 他轻快地走过走廊，没有停下。
words.en: To pass or complete something easily and successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 谨防；对……保持警惕
words.ex_cn: 要提防那些向你要钱的陌生人。
words.en: If you are wary of something or someone, you are cautious because you do not know much about them and you believe they may be dangerous or cause problems.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的边缘；在……的外围；处于……的外围区域
words.ex: He lives on the periphery of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的边缘。
words.en: Located at the edge or outer limit of something.

words.tr: phrase. 经过
words.ex: I saw a car pass by my house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一辆车从我家旁边开过。
words.en: To move past or go past something or someone without stopping or without paying attention to them.

words.tr: phrase. 关于；就……而言；与……有关
words.ex: He wrote to me in reference to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他写信给我，关于那次会议。
words.en: Used to indicate what something relates to or is about.

words.tr: phrase. 使…成为关注焦点；突出强调
words.ex: The news report throws the spotlight on poor school conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻报道将焦点对准了糟糕的学校条件。
words.en: To draw attention to something or someone, making them the focus of public interest or scrutiny.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.tr: phrase. 猛地撕掉；用力扯出；拆除；拔掉
words.ex: He ripped out the old page from his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他把笔记本里的旧页撕掉了。
words.en: To remove something quickly and forcefully by pulling it.

words.tr: phrase. 把…固定住；找某人问清；确定
words.ex: He used a nail to pin down the map on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他用钉子把地图固定在墙上。
words.en: To pin something down means to identify or define it clearly and precisely.

words.tr: phrase. 尤其是；特别是；相当重要地
words.ex: He is kind, smart, and not least, very hardworking.
words.ex_cn: 他善良、聪明，而且尤其勤奋。
words.en: You use not least to emphasize that a particular example or situation is especially important or significant.

words.tr: phrase. 自…起；从…开始（用于表示时间点）
words.ex: As of today, the project is finished.
words.ex_cn: 截至今天，项目已经完成了。
words.en: used to indicate the time or date from which something starts

words.tr: phrase. 可追溯到；能追溯到（某一时间、地点或原因）
words.ex: This tradition can be traced back to ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统可以追溯到古代。
words.en: If something can be traced back to a particular origin or cause, it started or was caused by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；遵循；坚持
words.ex: The sticker adheres to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 贴纸粘在墙上。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为伪装；假借……的名义
words.ex: He lied under the disguise of a friend.
words.ex_cn: 他以朋友的身份为伪装说谎。
words.en: If you do something under the disguise of a particular thing, you pretend to be that thing in order to do something else.

words.tr: phrase. 认为…理所当然；想当然
words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal without thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 充满（危险、困难或忧虑）的；伴有……的
words.ex_cn: 这次旅程充满了危险。
words.en: If a situation or action is fraught with problems or risks, it is filled with them.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住（机会等）；利用；突然注意到并加以利用
words.ex: He seized on the chance to speak.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住了发言的机会。
words.en: To take advantage of an opportunity or situation with enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 在损害...的情况下
words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但牺牲了自己的健康。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is done in a way that harms them or is unfair to them.

words.tr: phrase. 无论；不管
words.ex: No matter how tired I am, I finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 无论我多么累，我都会完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something is not important or does not affect the situation

words.tr: phrase. 以...的名义
words.ex: He acted in the name of justice.
words.ex_cn: 他以正义的名义行动。
words.en: If you do something in the name of a particular cause or principle, you do it in order to support that cause or principle.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守；照做；依从
words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, or rule.

words.tr: phrase. 在很大程度上；多半；非常
words.ex: He succeeded in great measure because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为努力工作而取得了很大的成功。
words.en: To a large extent or degree.

words.tr: phrase. 被绑在；被系在；被束缚
words.ex_cn: 他整天都离不开手机。
words.en: To be closely connected or associated with something; to be bound or restricted by something.

words.tr: phrase. 开拓前景；打开机遇；带来发展可能性
words.ex: Learning English can open up prospects for better jobs.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语可以打开更好工作的前景。
words.en: To create or reveal new opportunities or possibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 不管；不顾
words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.tr: phrase. 既然
words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为前提；基于……
words.ex: The plan is premised on good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划以好天气为基础。
words.en: to base a theory, argument, etc. on an idea, thought, or fact

words.tr: phrase. 盈亏；盛衰
words.ex: The moon waxes and wanes every month.
words.ex_cn: 月亮每月盈亏变化。
words.en: To increase and decrease in intensity or size, especially in reference to the moon's phases.

words.tr: phrase. 唯恐；以免；担心
words.ex: He left early for fear of missing the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早离开，怕赶不上公交车。
words.en: If you do something for fear of something else, you do it to avoid that other thing happening.

words.tr: phrase. 公开地；当众
words.ex: He sings in public every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在公共场合唱歌。
words.en: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; openly.

words.tr: phrase. 调查，审查：收集或搜集关于某事的信息。
words.ex: The police will inquire into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: To inquire into something means to investigate or examine it thoroughly in order to find out the facts about it.

words.tr: phrase. 证明；证实；作证说明
words.ex: He testified to the truth of what happened.
words.ex_cn: 他证明了所发生事情的真实性。
words.en: To testify to something means to provide evidence or proof of it, especially in a legal context.

words.tr: phrase. 对……保持警惕；注意……；警觉于……
words.ex_cn: 对河边的危险保持警惕。
words.en: To be vigilant or watchful towards something.

words.tr: phrase. 遵从；听从；把……推迟（某人）
words.ex: He defers to his boss's decision.
words.ex_cn: 他服从老板的决定。
words.en: If you defer to someone, you accept their opinion or do what they want you to do, especially because you respect them or their authority.

words.tr: phrase. 独自地；独立地
words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.tr: phrase. 被……所吸引的；对……感到好奇的
words.ex_cn: 他对魔术表演感到着迷。
words.en: To be very interested in something or someone, and want to know more about it or them.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为中心；重点在于…
words.ex: The lesson centers on basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这节课的重点是基本数学技能。
words.en: To have something as the main subject of attention or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 与…一致；与…协调；符合；依照
words.ex: The new rule is in keeping with the old policy.
words.ex_cn: 新规则与旧政策一致。
words.en: If something is in keeping with a particular style or tradition, it fits well with that style or tradition.

words.tr: phrase. 为此目的；为了达到这个目标
words.ex: He works hard to this end.
words.ex_cn: 他为此努力工作。
words.en: For this purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 栖息在…上；坐在…边缘；把…放置于高处
words.ex: The bird perches on the branch.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在树枝上。
words.en: To sit or rest on a high or narrow place.

words.tr: phrase. 以……而闻名；因……著称
words.ex: Italy is renowned for its pasta.
words.ex_cn: 意大利因意大利面而闻名。
words.en: To be famous or well known for something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.
